title: Draw & Guess
description: The ultimate party showdown of artistic skill and rapid deductions! Take turns sketching mystery words on a real-time canvas while friends race to guess the answer.
instructions: When it's your turn to draw, select your secret word and sketch clues on the canvas.
Do not write the letters of the word directly!
When other players draw, type your guesses in the chat box.
The quicker you guess correctly, the higher your bonus points!
controls: Color Palette & Brush Sizes: Adjust artistic tools
Chat Box: Type your guess and press Enter
